verdict: Instagram ads are profitable this period, but a thin product mix and weak local search presence cap growth.
diagnosis: This period, $5,442 in Instagram spend drove 637 purchases worth $26,799 — a return of roughly $4.90 for every $1 spent.

signals.headline: 637 purchases from $5,442 spend
signals.detail: Return on ad spend sits near 4.9x this period, well above the food and beverage benchmark of 3.2x.

signals.headline: Cost per purchase: $8.54
signals.detail: Dramatically below the food and beverage benchmark of roughly $23.88. The Lamb Escalopes video is doing real work.

signals.headline: Only 214 checkouts started, 637 bought
signals.detail: Odd ratio suggests tracking gaps or a very short path. Worth auditing before scaling spend.

signals.headline: 95 new reviews, 5-star latest average
signals.detail: Reputation momentum is strong this period. Review volume is a trust asset competitors like ButcherBox lean on heavily.

signals.headline: Zero clicks to call or directions
signals.detail: Google Business Profile is generating map impressions but no actions. The local listing is passive, not working.

benchmark.label: Benchmark
benchmark.subheader: Food and beverage leads Meta performance
benchmark.body: Food and beverage brands on Meta average a cost per purchase of $23.88 and a return of 3.2x. Billy Doe is beating both this period at $8.54 and roughly 4.9x.

seasonal.label: Seasonal
seasonal.subheader: Q4 Meta costs rising 15 to 25 percent
seasonal.body: Meta ad costs typically climb 15 to 25 percent in Q4 as holiday advertisers flood the auction. Current efficiency will likely compress through November and December.

competitor.label: Competitor
competitor.body: ButcherBox, with 400,000+ subscribers and $550M revenue pace, is pushing into Target's marketplace to acquire non-subscribers. Category pressure on one-time buyer acquisition is building.

recommendations.title: Scale the Lamb Escalopes video before Q4 costs climb
recommendations.detail: This single ad is delivering an $8.54 cost per purchase. Consider raising its daily budget 20 to 30 percent now, before holiday auction prices lift costs.

recommendations.title: Audit the checkout tracking gap
recommendations.detail: 637 purchases against only 214 initiated checkouts does not reconcile. Worth checking pixel setup and deduplication so decisions rest on clean numbers.

recommendations.title: Activate the Google Business Profile
recommendations.detail: Zero calls, zero direction requests despite map impressions. Consider adding offers, product posts, and a clear order link to convert local search intent.
